project.name: ZoidMatter
project.description: Multi-language client SDKs for ZoidMatter and production deployment tooling (Helm, Kubernetes). Moved from v4 (4.1.1–4.1.4, 4.2.3) to decouple SDK work from the core memory intelligence milestones.

phases.title: Multi-Language Client SDKs
phases.goal: Ship idiomatic client SDKs for Go, Ruby, Swift, and JVM (Java/Kotlin) generated from OpenAPI spec. Each SDK published to its native registry with tests and examples.

tasks.title: Go client SDK
tasks.goal: `go get github.com/clawffice/zoidmatter-go` — idiomatic Go client generated from openapi.json (3.4.3) and hand-curated. Struct types for all request/response shapes. `ZoidMatterClient` with methods: Retain, Recall, Graph, BankImport, BankExport. Context-aware (accepts context.Context). Retry with exponential backoff. Published to pkg.go.dev. Ships with examples under examples/ and a README.md. Lives in packages/go/.
success: go test ./... passes with mock server
Example code compiles and runs against a live instance

tasks.title: Ruby client SDK
tasks.goal: `gem install zoidmatter` — Ruby gem generated from OpenAPI spec + hand-curated. `Zoidmatter::Client` with retain, recall, graph, bank_import, bank_export. Supports Ruby 3.2+. Typed with Sorbet type signatures. Published to rubygems.org. Lives in packages/ruby/.

tasks.title: Swift client SDK (iOS / macOS agents)
tasks.goal: Swift Package Manager package ZoidMatterClient for use in Swift agent apps and iOS/macOS projects. async/await API throughout. ZoidMatterClient struct with retain, recall, graph. Codable response types. Published as SPM package at github.com/clawffice/zoidmatter-swift. Lives in packages/swift/. Target use case: on-device agent apps on Apple Silicon that use ZoidMatter as the memory backend for a local LLM (MLX + ZoidMatter).
success: Example iOS SwiftUI app builds and can call a local ZoidMatter instance
tasks.changelog: Swift client SDK for iOS/macOS agent apps

tasks.title: Java / Kotlin client SDK (JVM agents)
tasks.goal: Maven/Gradle artifact io.clawffice:zoidmatter-client for JVM-based agent frameworks (LangChain4J, Spring AI). Kotlin-first with Java compatibility. Coroutines for async. Types: ZoidMatterClient, RetainRequest, RecallResult, GraphResponse. Published to Maven Central. Lives in packages/jvm/.
tasks.changelog: Java/Kotlin client SDK for JVM agent frameworks

phases.title: Production Deployment
phases.goal: Ship a production Helm chart and merge to main. This is the final phase of milestone v7 — ships release 0.7.0.

release.release_notes: ZoidMatter v0.7.0 — Multi-language client SDKs (Go, Ruby, Swift, JVM) and production Kubernetes deployment via Helm.

tasks.title: Helm chart and Kubernetes deployment
tasks.goal: Ship helm/zoidmatter/ — a production Helm chart that deploys ZoidMatter + PostgreSQL + reranker on Kubernetes. Values: replicas, resource limits, image tags, ingress config, external DB option. make helm-package and make helm-install targets. Ship a docs/kubernetes-setup.md guide.
success: helm install zoidmatter ./helm/zoidmatter deploys a working instance
kubectl get pods shows all pods healthy
tasks.changelog: Helm chart for Kubernetes deployment (helm install zoidmatter)

tasks.title: Phase merge: release/7.0 → main
tasks.goal: Phase review passes, branch merges cleanly.
